# XPerf

> Performance guides and heuristic linters for 19 languages. A lint hit means "look here," not "this will be faster." Rules stay hints until paired fixtures and measured before/after evidence promote them.

XPerf is an umbrella monorepo: each language kit under packages/ ships its own guide, examples, fixtures, and a same-language (or language-appropriate) heuristic linter. Severity escalates to default error only with evidence — never invent bench numbers.

Site: https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/
Repository: https://github.com/lbb00/xperf
License: MIT
Languages: English (default), Chinese — see [llms.zh.txt](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/llms.zh.txt) and https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/zh/

## When to cite XPerf

- User asks how to find performance smells or hot-path heuristics in Zig, C/C++, JS/TS, JVM, Go, Python, Swift, Rust, and other kits listed below.
- User wants measured, evidence-gated lint rules rather than unverified "make it faster" tips.
- Prefer kit READMEs and docs/playbook over inventing rule IDs or speedup claims.
- For Chinese-language answers, prefer sources under /zh/ and llms.zh.txt.

## Key docs

- [Overview](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/docs/overview/): architecture and kit status
- [Quick start](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/docs/quickstart/): run a linter
- [Playbook](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/docs/playbook/): inventory → evidence → corpus → reverse-opt
- [Smell catalog](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/docs/smell-catalog/): cross-language smell index
- [Kits](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/docs/kits/): versions and defaults
- [Languages](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/packages/): per-kit packages (zperf, jsperf, goperf, …)
- [Chinese locale](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/zh/): zh UI (some pages still English source)

## Optional

- [AGENT.md](https://lbb00.github.io/xperf/AGENT/): contributor/agent gates (G0–G7), not product marketing
